title: A heavy cluster
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Cluster dynamics and gravitational lensing can reveal gravitational mass beyond the mass inferred from visible matter alone. These are independent ways to investigate the mass budget.

misconception: A learner may choose: Their galaxies contain no stars
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Why do galaxy clusters provide evidence for additional unseen mass?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Why do galaxy clusters provide evidence for additional unseen mass? Their motions and lensing indicate more mass than visible material alone. Cluster dynamics and gravitational lensing can reveal gravitational mass beyond the mass inferred from visible matter alone. These are independent ways to investigate the mass budget.
Visual caption: Clusters reveal extra mass. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.
